domain.scope: Finite-law oracle normalisation by coordinatewise convexity. Coordinate extrema are padded by the certified maximum rounding displacement, covering both ideal quantile enclosures and actual dyadics. Continuous/grid transfer has its own L box and nodal displacement proof.

C2_root_certificate.proof: Exactly one strictly decreasing log-ratio root on each outside component; no stationary point between zero and a; both Gaussian tails vanish.
